shortDescription: President Donald Trump said Nvidia NASDAQ:NVDA CEO Jensen Huang is happy to return to the role, calling it his “second term,” as the president again defended his intervention in the executive’s reinstatement despite bipartisan national security concerns.Speaking to reporters at Mar-a-Lago on Thursd…

children: CEO Jensen Huang is happy to return to the role, calling it his “second term,” as the president again defended his intervention in the executive’s reinstatement despite bipartisan national security concerns.

Speaking to reporters at Mar-a-Lago on Thursday, Trump said he had not spoken to Huang since Nvidia announced his return but added, “When I did speak to him, he is so happy to be going back. He calls it his second term.”

Trump dismissed concerns surrounding Huang’s reinstatement, saying, “Based on information and belief, I think he’s absolutely fine.” Asked what information he had, Trump offered no specifics, saying only, “The information I have, which is a lot of information.”

Trump had pushed Nvidia’s board to reinstate Huang and enlisted Vice President JD Vance to make a personal appeal. The move drew criticism from both parties, with lawmakers calling for scrutiny of Huang’s ties to the administration. Huang is scheduled to testify privately before House lawmakers on Dec. 1 and publicly before the Senate on Dec. 3.

Nvidia shares surged more than 31% on Monday following the announcement but fell more than 9.5% over the next two sessions. Trump said, “I will tell you, the market feels very good about it,” adding that he believed he had done “a great thing for our country and even for the world.”
Trump is scheduled to attend a groundbreaking event for Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing
chip plant expansion in Arizona on Dec. 4. Asked whether Huang might join him, Trump said, “I would be glad to take him.”

title: Trump says Huang is excited about his 'second term' at Nvidia
